scope: The guarded native projection, recursive series, parameter, truth, local binding, join, compound, mutation, declaration and transaction boundaries. The field-binding shapes require exact source-occurrence and declared-slot identity for wildcard and explicit projections. PostgreSQL merged joins check the resolved origin chain, exact declared key comparison and binary placement.

The value primitive digests bind the checked list copy, assertion behavior and snapshot restrictions.
